# contract-testing

Provider/consumer contract testing and property-based boundary fuzzing - Pact and Schemathesis are the tools the TESTING rules measure reports from.

## Detected anti-patterns

### `AF-TEST-001` — The contract is executable — provider and consumer sides (high)

An OpenAPI file that nothing verifies drifts silently; contract tests prove the provider serves what it publishes and consumers only use what is published — the two failure modes the judge already detects statically.

Remediation: Run provider-side schema validation on real responses and consumer-driven contract tests (Pact/Schemathesis) in CI; gate merges on divergence findings, not on "docs updated".

Reference: docs/specs/2026-09-21-api-forge-agentic-platform.md

### `AF-TEST-002` — Fuzz the boundary the contract declares (medium)

Hand-written tests cover the cases the author imagined; property/ schema fuzzing (Schemathesis, restler) covers the space the contract admits — malformed types, boundary values, unexpected nulls.

Remediation: Fuzz every operation against its declared schema in CI; treat 5xx on contract-valid input as a defect and on contract-invalid input as a validation gap.

Reference: https://schemathesis.readthedocs.io/

### `AF-TEST-007` — Contract-breaking changes are detected before merge (high)

A breaking change discovered by consumers after deploy costs a rollback or a forced migration; diffing baseline vs candidate contract in CI makes the decision explicit and cheap.

Remediation: Run `apiforge diff contract --baseline v1 --candidate v2` (or the equivalent) on every contract change; fail on unclassified breaking changes, require an approved ADR for classified ones.

Reference: docs/decisions/ADR-002-api-ir-provenance.md

### `AF-TEST-102` — Schemathesis found contract-violating responses (high)

Schemathesis failures are responses the contract does not allow — missing validation, wrong status codes, or schema drift; each is a client-visible defect already proven against the spec.

Remediation: Reproduce the failing check cases; fix the serializer/validator first, then re-run — a clean schemathesis run is the floor for contract conformance.

Reference: https://schemathesis.readthedocs.io/
